purpose: Teach: スリップ/安部/スパイク/発光/王妃/ラケット/昆布/ノンフィクション

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、自転車で、雨の日、スリップ、本気で、危なかったよ、私、お互いに、気をつけような、絶対。
lines.en: Riku, you could've really slipped on that wet road. We both need to be more careful. Seriously.
lines.style: Urgent concern breaking through a wry surface. Short, sharp attack. Leans forward slightly. Real worry underneath the directness, but she won't say it plain.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。隣のクラスの安部、本当に、面白い奴だぜ、桜、お前、知り合い?紹介できるよ、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: Yeah. There's this guy Abe in the next class—he's genuinely funny. Sakura, do you know him? I could introduce you.
lines.style: Bright, engaged. Lifts on the offer, like he's genuinely excited to connect them. Casual confidence without pushiness. Leans in a little.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: バレー部、お前のスパイク、本気で、決まると、皆、興奮するよね、リク、見てて、本気で、本当に、すごい。
lines.en: When you spike in volleyball, everyone gets so into it. Riku, I'm serious—it's incredible to watch.
lines.style: Sincere admiration cutting through. No performance. Direct eye contact. Warm but steady. The words land because she means them, not because she's trying to please.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭の発光看板、本気で、お洒落になったぜ、桜、お前、見たか?本気で、感心するレベルだ、絶対。
lines.en: That LED sign they made for the festival turned out really cool. Did you see it, Riku? That was seriously impressive work.
lines.style: Engaged and bright. The enthusiasm is real but measured—not over-the-top. Shares the observation like inviting him to notice something good. Steady warmth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 歴史の授業で、王妃の話、本当に、面白かったよね、リク、お前、覚えてる?本気で、印象に、残ったよ、絶対。
lines.en: That history lesson about the queen was actually fascinating, don't you think? Riku, do you remember it? That one really stuck with me.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity. Softer pace than the previous lines. Testing whether he remembers, wants to share the moment. Slight hesitation—checking if he cares about the same things.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の家、テニスラケット、何本、あるんだ?お父さんも、お母さんも、好きみたいだよな、本気で、絶対、すごい家族。
lines.en: Your parents have so many tennis rackets at home. Both your mom and dad really love it, huh? That's pretty cool.
lines.style: Casual observation tinged with real curiosity. Not prying, just noticing. Slight warmth at the family picture. Relaxed, genuine interest without intensity.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お弁当に、昆布の佃煮、お母さん、入れてくれたよ、本当に、美味しいんだ、リク、お前、食べてみたい?
lines.en: My mom packed konbu tsukudani in my lunch today. It's really good—want to try some?
lines.style: Open, gentle offer. Slight brightness without demanding. Offering not just food but a small inclusion. Comfortable silence would be fine too.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 最近、ノンフィクションの本、お父さん、本気で、勧めてくるんだぜ、桜、お前、知ってる?読みやすいの、ある?
lines.en: My dad's been pushing non-fiction on me lately. Do you know any good ones? Anything that's easy to get into?
lines.style: Casual, seeking-his-input tone. Genuine question, not performance. Warm but low-key. The kind of thing you ask someone you actually want advice from.
